summary: Iter 29 — dispute safety valve, admin data export, and Claude Listing Assistant. 14/14 backend pytest tests pass + all 3 frontend flows green. Backend: sweep as artist→403; sweep resolves 8-day-old carrier-delivered not_received dispute A to 'reject' (auto_resolved true, order fulfillment→delivered, payout release_at set + hold_reason='dispute_rejected'); B (damaged, no session_id) stays open with auto_resolve_error and one 'dispute_auto_failed' admin notification; C (5-day-old) gets auto_warned + one 'dispute_auto_warning' admin notification; second sweep is idempotent (no re-warn/re-notify). Settings PATCH dispute_auto_days=10 persists and is exposed via public /api/settings; 1→422; restored to 7. /api/admin/export.zip → 200 application/zip with the 6 files, users scrubbed of password_hash/twofa_secret/recovery_codes/trusted_devices, users.csv header valid; artist→403; anon→401. Listing-assist: valid draft returned with all keys, medium ∈ MEDIUMS, 5-8 tags, price_low ≤ suggested ≤ high; another user's image_path→404, bogus path→404, buyer→403, missing image_path→422. Frontend /studio/upload: assist-tip visible before image, listing-assistant card appears after upload, assist-run-btn returns draft in ~10-15s with 'Primary Forms After Dark' + $250, apply fills art-title/art-description/art-price=250, Save & Continue posts artwork and redirects (fee flow). Frontend /admin Settings: dispute-auto-days-input change to 9 persists across reload; admin-export-btn triggers Playwright download 'artcore-export-2026-09-23.zip'. Frontend /notifications: both 'Dispute auto-resolves in 2 days — review it' and 'Dispute auto-resolve failed — needs you' labels render for admin.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_tools.sweep_stale_disputes iterates disputes with `.to_list(200)` — with growth this cap could silently drop old disputes from a single sweep run. Consider pagination or removing the limit.

In the failure branch, `if not d.get('auto_resolve_error')` guards double-notify, but the `auto_resolve_error` is overwritten with the latest error each sweep — losing the original error history. Consider `$push` to an errors array or `$setOnInsert`-style guard.

listing_assist.py: `raise HTTPException(400, ...)` inside an `except Exception` swallows all Pillow errors as 'Could not read that image' — including HTTPException that FastAPI may raise from get_object; add explicit re-raise for HTTPException. Minor.

admin_tools.export_all pulls up to 200k rows per collection into memory + zips in a single request — fine for MVP scale, but for large datasets this will OOM or time out through k8s ingress. Consider streaming/chunked export.
SettingsUpdate model has no dispute_auto_days upper bound consistent with UI (UI max=30, Pydantic ge=2,le=30 — good, matches). Ok.
